description: Terms in Markdown that scroll, with an accept button that enables once the end was reached.

props.name: version
props.description: The version of the terms, sent with `onAccepted`.

props.name: scrollHint
props.default: Scroll to the end to accept
props.description: Shown, and spoken, while the end has not been reached.

events.name: onAccepted
events.description: Fires with the version when the user accepts.

events.name: onLink
events.description: Fires with the address of a tapped link; wire it to the `openUrl` action.
